create_world_instance: create a World instance with opts and spec to initialize a simulated Minecraft world with blocks and mobs
place_block_in_world: place a block at a given XYZ location in the World using the place_block method
dig_block_at_location: dig a block at a given XYZ location in the World using the dig method
get_blocks_in_region: get a numpy array of blocks within a bounding box region using get_blocks
step_world_simulation: step the World simulation forward by one tick advancing all mob states
